definition: A project requires engineering-level repair when a project-specific code, timeline, or rendered media correction is needed to pass QC after the accepted pipeline is run. Shared engine calibration before a final accepted run, script/cover input revisions, and deliberate candidate selection tests are excluded.
assessment_method: Reviewed the READY_FOR_REVIEW run history and QC evidence for all 20 final projects. Every accepted run completed technical, content and visual QC and package checks without a project-specific engineering patch.

projects.evidence: Accepted pipeline completed to READY_FOR_REVIEW; technical, content, visual QC and package checks passed with no project-specific engineering correction.
